install: export ANDROID_HOME="${ANDROID_HOME:-/opt/android-sdk}"; SDKM="$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"; if [ -x "$SDKM" ] && { [ ! -d "$ANDROID_HOME/platforms/android-36" ] || [ ! -d "$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools/35.0.0" ]; }; then yes | "$SDKM" --licenses >/dev/null || true; "$SDKM" --install 'platforms;android-36' 'build-tools;35.0.0' 'platform-tools'; fi; chmod +x ./gradlew && ./gradlew --no-daemon --console=plain :app:dependencies --configuration debugRuntimeClasspath -q > /dev/null
